description: Search products by query, optionally scoped to a storefront and category, with pagination.

category.description: Product category name or slug to filter by (see get_categories for a store's categories).

query.description: Free text over product name and description, e.g. 'iphone 13', 'shea butter'.

storefrontSlug.description: Limit results to one store by its slug (from search_storefronts). Omit to search across all verified stores.

name: search_products
